limits: The two SDK cases use actual pinned OpenCode/runnerd binaries and a local signed software Host with deterministic HTTP responses. They do not qualify a live provider, physical isolation, prices or a release. Existing fixture discovery is not reclassified as genuine OpenCode provider conformance.

The 45 selected Native dispatch owner cases exclude the retained legacy attachment-staging case. That case still fails its original unsupported mock transport admission and must be ported through real admission before suite acceptance. No assertion or production admission is weakened.

The namespace-link regression proves exact-target-only idempotence; the complete second temporal journey still needs actual requalification. SDK6 closed interruption diagnostic wiring compiles but has no passing SDK6 claim.
All 169 requirement statuses and migration phase statuses remain unchanged. Earlier failed, deadline-stopped and memory-stopped attempts remain private diagnostics and are not passing evidence.
